name: Luminary AI
description: Early-stage startup building an LLM-powered contract analysis tool for legal teams. The product uses GPT-4 to extract clauses, flag risks, and summarize contracts. We have 5 employees, $800K in seed funding, and are processing real customer contracts in production. No formal security review has been conducted. We are pre-revenue and targeting law firms and enterprise legal departments in the US and EU.
